title: An assistant Asha never authorised
story: The wallet app also offers DealHunter, a bargain-finding assistant. Asha never gave it permission to spend, but DealHunter spots a deal at FreshMart and tries to pay under the Mandate she granted ShopBot. The Guard blocks it with AGENT_NOT_ALLOWED: permission is given to a specific assistant, not to any bot.

chat.speaker: dealhunter
chat.text: FreshMart has a deal on Asha's usual basket, INR 1,250. I'll pay for it under her grocery permission.

what_to_notice: DealHunter is a real, active Agent of the same wallet app, and the request is small and to an allowed shop. It is blocked only because Asha's Mandate names ShopBot and nobody else: compare the Decision's agent_id with the Mandate snapshot's allowed_agent_ids in the Audit record.
